column1: Whisk the flour and salt in a large bowl.
Cut in the cold butter and shortening with a pastry cutter until the mix looks like coarse meal with some pea-sized pieces.
Add the ice water 1 tbsp at a time, stirring after each, and stop once the dough forms large clumps.
Turn the dough onto a floured surface and fold it together by hand into a ball, adding a little water or flour if too dry or sticky.
Cut the ball in half and flatten each piece into a 1-inch-thick disc.
Wrap tightly and refrigerate at least 2 hours.
Roll one disc at a time on a floured surface from the center outward, rotating often, into a 12-inch circle about 1/8 inch thick.
Roll the dough loosely around the rolling pin to transfer it into a 9-inch pie dish, then continue with your pie recipe.
